usdRate.note: Secondary source (BCH site could not be read); World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF gives 25.95 for 2025.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics: Honduras inflation rate (BCH/INE data)
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: the Banco Central de Honduras site could not be read by machine. 6.20% in August 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Trading Economics indicators: inflation expectations 4.95% (Aug 2026); World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG 4.6% (2025)
inflation_projection.note: Expected inflation near 5% and a recent average of about 5-6% (higher in 2022), so we plan with a rounded 5%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics: Honduras interest rate (BCH tasa de política monetaria)
policy_rate.note: Secondary source; unchanged from the previous reading.

savings_account_rate.note: The BCH interest rate statistics pages are rendered by script and could not be read; no savings rate found from a permitted source.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No 3-month term deposit rate found; the BCH statistics pages could not be read.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No 1-year term deposit rate found; the BCH statistics pages could not be read.

dps_rate.note: No official series for monthly recurring deposits was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: IMF IFS deposit rate via the World Bank; up from 8.91% in 2024, reflecting tight bank liquidity in 2025.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond sold directly to individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current 91-day bill yield found from an official or permitted source.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year government bond yield found from an official or permitted source.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond yield found from an official or permitted source.

tax_bank_interest.note: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries (reviewed 10 August 2026) does not state the tax on deposit interest for resident individuals; no official SAR source could be read.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found, so no tax rate applies to report.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: FOSEDE: Resolución No. 341/18-02-2025, suma máxima asegurada para el año 2025
deposit_insurance_limit.note: L245,715 per depositor per institution for 2025 (the legal USD 9,632.92 base at the BCH selling rate of L25.5069); the amount is reset each January and no 2026 resolution was found.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or official average credit card rate was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Global equity index in lempira terms
equity_return_low.note: Low case: weak global equities and a stable lempira.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in lempira terms; lempira 26.88 per dollar (Oct 2026) vs about 24.6 in 2023
equity_return_base.note: The local exchange lists few shares, so we use a global equity index (about 7% in dollars) plus about 2% a year of lempira depreciation.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity index in lempira terms
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equities and faster depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with mild lempira depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price; lempira exchange rate trend
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4.5% a year plus about 2.5% lempira depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case if deposit rates fall back with the 5.75% policy rate.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case well below the 2025 peak average deposit rate, allowing for tax and normalising liquidity.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case if term deposit rates stay near 2024-2025 levels.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio from the CNBS was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold, but no published per-1,000 premium rates by age from the regulator or another permitted source were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No public premium table for private health insurance by age was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Trading Economics: Honduras inflation rate (6.28%, Sept 2026)
goal_inflation_health.note: No health price index rate was read; private care tends to outpace headline, so we plan with 1.5 points above the 5% assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Trading Economics indicators: CPI education index
goal_inflation_education.note: No education inflation rate was read; tuition usually rises faster than headline, so we plan with 6%.

life_expectancy.note: Men 70.5, women 75.7 (2024). UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net gives 73.4 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium-variant projections for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.97 (2025, World Bank), 10.4 (2040) and 24.2 (2065, populationpyramid.net/honduras/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The IHSS old-age pension (régimen IVM) page shows its rules only as images, and PwC and the international databases could not be read, so the pension age is not confirmed.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: INJUPEMP: preguntas frecuentes (requisitos de jubilación voluntaria)
retirement_age_government.note: Public employees' fund: retirement at 62 with 15 years of service for those retiring from 2032 or aged 43 or less in 2013 (anyone born after 1975); 60 with 13 years for 2024-2027 and 61 with 14 years for 2028-2031.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case if deposit rates fall back with the policy rate.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case well below the average deposit rate, allowing for tax and normalising rates.

retirement_return_high.note: High case if deposit rates stay high.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Deposit rates; global equity index in lempira terms
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of deposits and global equities.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Deposit rates; global equity index in lempira terms
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: about half global equities at 9% and half deposits at 7%, rounded down.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Deposit rates; global equity index in lempira terms

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No official source on a non-contributory old-age pension for Honduras, or its amount, could be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No official source on a non-contributory old-age pension for Honduras could be read.

gratuity_rule.note: Severance (auxilio de cesantía) exists under the Labour Code, but no readable official or permitted source confirming the days-per-year rules was found.

public_pension_scheme.note: The IHSS runs the contributory invalidity, old-age and death pension (employees pay 1% of insurable pay up to L11,903.13, per PwC), but its age and benefit rules could not be read from a permitted source.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product with a published rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond is sold directly to individuals.

tbill_91d.note: No retail treasury bill programme was found.

tbond_5y.note: No retail channel for 5-year government bonds was confirmed.

tbond_10y.note: No retail channel for 10-year government bonds was confirmed.

equity_fund.note: No diversified equity index fund for retail investors was found.

gold.note: Gold can be bought legally from jewellers.

insuranceRegulator.name: Comisión Nacional de Bancos y Seguros (CNBS)

pensionScheme.name: Instituto Hondureño de Seguridad Social (IHSS), régimen de invalidez, vejez y muerte

publicHealthCover.name: Secretaría de Salud (public health services)
publicHealthCover.note: Formal-sector workers are covered by the IHSS sickness and maternity scheme.
